address: Rue des Fossés Fleuris 18, Namur, 5000, Belgium
bio: Charles Jeandrain of the starred establishment, Attablez-vous, has opened this buzzy eatery in Namur’s pedestrian centre. Diners can choose between a bargain-priced lunch menu, an enticing set menu and a few suggestions, all of which are in line with Jeandrain’s focus on authentic, unfussy flavours. Examples include a tartare of raw shrimp with finely diced celeriac and apple, a sweet curry emulsion and a crunchy salad, followed by a textbook perfect vol-au-vent. Just the ticket to share a meal with friends and family in Namur....
